grounding.states: Babies get the most out of naps when they nap at the same time each day for about the same length of time
grounding.from: Babies get the most out of naps if they take them at the same time each day and for about the same length of time.

grounding.states: A dark, quiet room can help babies sleep
grounding.from: A dark, quiet room can help babies sleep.

grounding.states: Put babies to bed drowsy but awake
grounding.from: put babies to bed drowsy but awake, since they sleep best when drowsy

grounding.states: A calming routine such as a story read in a calm voice or soft lullabies helps
grounding.from: a story read in a calming voice; soft lullabies, swaddling or massage before the baby gets too tired or cranky

grounding.states: For babies, put them to sleep on their backs with no blankets, stuffed toys or other soft items in the crib
grounding.from: Put babies to sleep on their backs, with no blankets, stuffed toys or other soft items in the crib or bassinet.

value.answer: Depends who "him" is, so here's the baby version: nap at the same time and for about the same length each day, keep the room dark and quiet, do a calm routine like a story or a lullaby, and put him down drowsy but awake. For a baby, always on his back with nothing soft in the crib. How old is he?
